correctness.rationale: The trace companion matrix identity is directly checked, its thirteenth power is I+3A with tr(A)=12, and r=1,3,9 yield unit trace slopes 17,29,158. For h>0 the inequality v3(3^j binom(h,j)) >= v3(h)+2 for j>=2 proves exact local isometry after dividing by 3. Each isometry induces a bijection on every finite ternary residue ring and hence a unique 3-adic zero. Counting one, six, or nine progressions gives exactly the stated densities and a bound of nine for all levels and cutoffs. A fresh Python implementation checks 119,998 recurrence values, 15 lifted digits and the levelwise cutoff inequalities; these computations supplement but do not replace the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: Published Perrin valuation formulae focus on prime two. The prime-three classification is a natural but structurally different invariant: exactly three nontrivial isometric branches modulo thirteen, an effective local-root parameterization, exact frequencies at every valuation, and an error bounded independently of the valuation level. This is a complete infinite-level arithmetic description, not a finite empirical table, mere rewrite or arbitrarily selected slice.
